0022600111.text: The Phoenix Suns, 0-1 and 15th in the West, host the 0-1 Golden State Warriors in the Suns' second game of the season. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (out, oblique strain), and Luke Kennard is day-to-day with a knee strain and a game-time decision, while Golden State is missing Charles Bassey (out, knee), Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Suns lost the season series 1-3, most recently a 101-97 loss in Phoenix on February 5, 2026.
